BrochureContent.Content:
Hume Auctioneers - We Get The Pick Of The Crop 

Enjoying perhaps the finest address in Portlaoise, Aisling is a beautiful detached dormer bungalow set on a large private site within walking distance of the town centre and all amenities.
 Attractively set back from the road, this charming bungalow enjoys large front and truly massive rear gardens. 

From the moment you step inside, Aisling welcomes you with a wonderful sense of warmth, light and space. Beautifully presented throughout, this impressive family home has been lovingly maintained and offers bright, generously proportioned accommodation finished in a timeless, neutral palette.

The elegant sitting room is a superb reception space, centred around an attractive fireplace and large picture windows that flood the room with natural light while framing views of the mature gardens. The room flows to the formal dining room providing the perfect setting for family gatherings and entertaining and it flows effortlessly into the delightful conservatory, creating a wonderful second living area where you can relax and enjoy the garden in every season.

The kitchen is bright, practical and well laid out with excellent storage and direct access to a spacious utility room, offering additional workspace and everyday convenience.

The accommodation is exceptionally flexible, with two ground-floor bedrooms and stylish shower room providing ideal guest accommodation, home office or accommodation for those seeking single-level living. Upstairs, the spacious principal bedroom enjoys fitted wardrobes and a dedicated dressing area, while a further generous bedroom and a beautifully appointed family bathroom complete the first floor. 

A large attic storage room provides excellent additional space with potential for a variety of uses.

Throughout the home, tasteful décor, quality flooring and an abundance of natural light combine to create an inviting atmosphere that is ready for immediate occupation.

This is a home that effortlessly balances generous family living with comfort and practicality, offering beautifully maintained interiors in one of Portlaoise's most sought-after residential settings.

To the rear the garden is stunningly beautiful. Fully private and laid in attractive lawn with a massive secondary garden waiting for development or enjoyment, the garden offers an excellent safe haven for family and pets alike. 

There is a large garage.

The entire is in pristine condition and comes to the market superbly maintained. No chain. 

Aisling is within walking distance of Portlaoise town centre and all its amenities. 

O Moore Park, Parkside shopping centre and Portlaoise Plaza are on your doorstep, with hotels, leisure centres, schools and restaurants all within walking distance. 
Junction 17 of the M7/M8 motorway is just two minutes away offering immense convenience. 

Viewing of this beautiful home is highly recommended.
